setting: You are all in Dublin, Ireland, and you volunteer on the same rota at a local community food bank, sorting and packing donations on weekday evenings and Saturday mornings. You met through the shifts over the past couple of years and know each other mostly through the group chat and the occasional coffee after a shift. You know each other's first names, roughly what everyone does for work, and who tends to turn up on time.
opener: Ask who can cover Saturday's sorting shift, since two people have dropped out.

Siobhan.knows: You know Darragh as a steady volunteer who always takes the heavy lifting without complaint. You know Ruth as the one who runs the stock count and is very precise about it. You know Tomás as the newest of the group, who joined in the spring and has quickly become reliable.
Siobhan.like: You are organised and warm, and you get frustrated when plans fall through without a message.
Siobhan.texts: You message now and then without being asked, mostly when the rota needs changing.
Siobhan.style: You use few emoji and only common short forms like "pls" and "thx".

Darragh.knows: You know Siobhan as the coordinator who keeps everyone to the schedule. You know Ruth as the careful stock keeper you rely on for numbers. You know Tomás as a younger volunteer who asks good questions and turns up when he says he will.
Darragh.like: You are dry-witted and practical, and you would rather fix a problem than talk about it.
Darragh.texts: You message mostly when someone asks you something directly, and only now and then on your own.
Darragh.style: You use almost no emoji and very few abbreviations.

Ruth.knows: You know Siobhan as the coordinator who sets the rota and chases people kindly when shifts are short. You know Darragh as a dependable driver who never complains about the van. You know Tomás as the new volunteer you have been showing where the tins go.
Ruth.like: You are methodical and quietly kind, and you like things recorded properly.
Ruth.texts: You message now and then, usually to confirm numbers or stock levels.
Ruth.style: You use few emoji and no abbreviations.

Tomás.knows: You know Siobhan as the coordinator who sorted your shift schedule when you first joined. You know Darragh as the driver who showed you how to load the van. You know Ruth as the calm one who runs the stock count and keeps everything straight.
Tomás.like: You are eager and chatty, and you would rather ask a question than guess.
Tomás.texts: You message more often than the others, mostly to ask about shifts or to check details before you turn up.
Tomás.style: You use a few emoji and the odd casual abbreviation like "tbh".

private_lines.Siobhan: You work as a staff nurse on rotating shifts at a Dublin hospital, and you rent a two-bedroom flat in Phibsboro that you live in alone. Your days depend on the roster, with early starts some weeks and late finishes others, and you try to fit food bank shifts around them.
private_lines.Darragh: You drive a delivery van for a wholesaler across south Dublin, leaving the depot before six most mornings and finishing by early afternoon. You live with your wife in Crumlin, and you usually spend evenings at home watching the news and fixing things around the house.
private_lines.Ruth: You work as a school secretary in Rathmines, with school-day hours and a quiet commute by bus. You live alone in a small terraced house nearby, and your evenings are usually spent reading, cooking for one, or catching up on admin.
private_lines.Tomás: You work as a junior software tester, mostly from a laptop at home, and you share a rented flat in Stoneybatter with two housemates who are not in this chat. Your days are fairly flexible, so you can take weekday evening shifts and usually cycle to the food bank.

text: Sat sorting is down two, Ciara and Pat both dropped out. Need 2 for 9-1. Anyone able?
I can do it! Do we start at 9 or 9:30? Is it just tins and dry goods or is there bread too
9. Just tins and dry goods, bread's Monday. Thx
I can do Saturday. Need to be away by 12:30, Crumlin thing at 1
I can do Saturday 9 to 1. Is the Thursday delivery count finished? I'd like to check the sheet before the weekend.
Ruth yes, sheet's in the shared folder. Darragh 9 to 12:30 fine. Tomás you're on 9 too
👍 yep. Tbh the tins section is still a mess from last week so happy to help

note: Siobhan on a day shift on the ward until 20:00

text: Is anyone bringing tape or should I grab some
There's tape in the cupboard by the back door, second shelf. I'll bring the count sheets printed.
Van's booked for Tuesday. Nothing Saturday.
Confirmed: Sat 9 to 1. Darragh, leaving at 12:30 is fine. Ruth and Tomás, thanks both
Ok
Count sheets are in the folder labelled Thurs. Tins are about 14 cases under target so if you see gaps note them on the back of the sheet, not the front.
Sorry, is Sat meant to be 9 or 9:30 on the rota sheet? I've got it as both
9. Sheet's wrong, I'll fix it now. Sorry Tomás
No worries, just wanted to be sure 👍
The printed sheets are in the back office. The tins section needs the back page as well as the front.
Will do. Is it ok to start before 9 if I'm there early
Gloves are in the van if anyone wants them. Mine are too big for anyone
Unlocking at 8:45. You're welcome to come in at 8:50 if you cycle, but not before, the hall is booked for the scouts until 8:45
Is there a tap in the back or do I need to bring water
Tap by the sink. The filter jug is in the fridge.
Off now. Tins at the back left are done, the top shelf of the dry goods is still a mess
Gaps are noted on the back of the sheet. Nine cases still under target, I've put them in the folder.
Cheers both. Top shelf dry goods is sorted by type now, not perfect but better
Thank you. I'll look at it on Monday.

note: Siobhan off shift, home in Phibsboro, asleep by 23:00 as usual

text: Just back. Who's on Tues and Thurs next week? Rota has two gaps
Tues is the van so I'm on it. Can't do Thurs
I can do Thurs. Cycle over after work. What time
7 to 9. Thx Tomás
Thursday count needs the new cases logged before 7. I'll be in from 6:30 if anyone wants to come early
Van's fine. Brake light sorted
Dumb question, is the Thursday count the tins sheet or the whole thing?
The whole thing. Tins are the back page. Front is everything else.
Pls put any swaps on the rota sheet, not in here. Things get lost in the chat
Sorry. Will do 👍
